reviews.text:
UPDATE— just had our last vet visit here because we’re moving out of state, but we just wanted to say thank you for all the care and love you’ve provided for Oliver & Sadie!! They’ve made sure that our pups feel as comfortable as they can during vet visits and always have been transparent about pricing and guidance before starting any procedures. It can be hard to find a vet that you trust, so we were very happy to find village west vet! Special shout out to Reina for always treating our dogs with so much love and taking the time to answer our questions. We will def miss this clinic!!
——————————————————————————

Just had our first vet visit here with our dogs, Oliver and Sadie! Everyone was so kind and gentle with our dogs, from Cece at the front desk, Chelimar as our technician, Jimmy as the groomer, and Dr. Konishi as our vet. They provided lots of treats with different options and made sure there were no allergies. They prioritized making our pets and us feel more comfortable and were upfront about costs. We are so happy to find a new vet we can trust our dogs with, and Oliver and Sadie look forward to many more fun trips! :)
Everyone was so nice and patient with our pup. Also priced really well and very knowledgeable team. Highly recommended.

I have been taking my dog to Village West Vet for five years now. Our former vet clinic was quite horrible and left me with a lot of fear and anxiety for how my dog and I would be treated. I can personally attest that every time I come here the staff is extremely welcoming and caring. They are happy to answer questions and are quite helpful with helping me plan out future visits. Instead of feeling worse after our visits, I leave feeling confident and content with the treatment my dog receives. Making appointments is quite easy and it’s an added bonus the number of services offered here. This is the only place I trust when it comes to treating my fur baby.
Very patient and caring

Village West Vet, including Cece, Manny, and Dr. Aylesworth, were attentive, compassionate, and informative. They were able to squeeze us in just a few hours later on the same day when I suspected my cat had a UTI. We were in and out in about an hour, and I felt that my 20-year-old beauty was truly cared for every step of the way. She has been coming to this location for about ten years or more, and I’m so grateful for the wonderful care she has received over the years.

Highly recommend Village West Vet!
Did an incredible job with our pet! Very compassionate and kind all around. Got same day appts for a sick and healthy cat. Office moves quickly too! Would highly recommend to anyone in Chicago!!!
Thank you for the 5-stars!

We have been brining our staffy, Gus, to Village West Vet for about 2 years and it has been by far the best experience at a vet we’ve ever had. The staff is always friendly and happy to see Gus they treat him like one of their own family. Aside from being friendly they are extremely knowledgeable, they always take the time to clearly explain all treatments and recommendations and their communication outside of appointments is quick should we ever need anything.

I’ve never had a dog that actually loved going to the Vet until we went to Village West Vet!

My corgi Monty came in needing 3 vaccines and the technician and doctor were so kind and loving to him. He was so scared and they calmed him down so well with cheese and gentle affirmations. Thank you so much!!

One thing that truly sets this practice apart is how much they care about the people behind the pets. They take the time to explain every option, respect your budget and comfort level, and never make you feel judged—making you feel like a partner in your pet’s care rather than just the bank account.
Friendly, caring, knowledgeable staff /be patient though, they want to make sure you understand your options/costs

Dr. Aylesworth was incredible good to my dog, as was the assistant who saw us before him. They took the time to explain my choices, detail price differences and give opinions on which services I should go with. Plus they kept Stell enjoying the treats! I would highly recommend them.
Che and Dr. Aylesworth are wonderful! Very friendly, thorough and answered all of my questions! Che even picked the cutest bandana for my cat!

My little guy Charlie was so nervous and by the end he was purring and meowing.

I can't say enough good things about my first visit here. The front office staff was incredible and shifted around their schedule to work with me.

The vets I met were very informative and walked me through everything. They answered every question I had and really put me at ease.

So glad to have found such a great vet that is close to home!
Prompt and comprehensive

This vet practice is very accomodating, flexible, and kind to my pet. My senior dog has had many health issues the past year, and they have helped both of us through all of it with kindness and love towards my pet. My dog loves coming here because of the attention and love he gets. I heard multiple people were cheering him on and giving him love while going through a difficult procedure which made me feel super greatful. As for cost, it is expensive (as all vets seem to be in the city these days) but they are transparent and flexible before doing anything.

Highly reccomended!
Jimmy is the BEST groomer!!! He does an excellent and thorough job. He loves animals and you can tell by the way they respond to him.
Explains everything thoroughly and very patient with my dog.
Thank you for the 5-star rating!! We are happy to hear you had a great experience with our team🐾 …
Thank you for the 5-star rating. We're glad your experience with Village West Veterinary was positive.
Showed up at 8am in the hopes of getting a same-day (immediate) appointment and got me right in. Grateful for the availability!

I live nearby so initially chose this practice for the location; however, the staff is very kind and patient with my sassy and nervous girl, Rory! They always give her extra treats and take the time to make her feel more comfortable-- especially when she was so nervous to come back after having to induce vomiting because she ate an entire bag of candied ginger. Thanks for helping Aurora always feel her best! And they now also have an incredible groomer to keep her looking her best as well!  Thank you all!

We adopted two stay kittens last summer, and this week was their first annual exam (since they got their original care and shots through the adoption agency before we adopted them). I was nervous about it because they're still a bit skittish and don't like being picked up, let alone put in carriers. Trying to not be late meant that I ended up getting to our appointment about 15 minutes early, but the Village West team was great! They saw us smoothly and were very reassuring to me and the cats. I can also say that they were supportive with our previous cat who passed away about 2 years ago from liver failure at the age of 16.

I've been to four different vets for my dog Sheila and they have gave me nothing on what is wrong with her, etc. only to give her medication for the last six months and telling me medication or obviously the option to do something that no dog owners want to do I found village West and the doctor was amazing. Did multiple different tests that know their vet has done gave me a certain medication for Sheila this time that was this past Wednesday. Sheila has improved so much since then I know it's temporary but moral of the story village West is great and understanding and really looks out for the dog and the owner.
Thank you for the 5 STARS Daisy 🌟 …

I had to schedule a very last minute appointment for my dog and was able to easily book online. The staff was so friendly and helpful, and my dog got the help he needed. They were informative and thorough which I greatly appreciate.

My wife and I have been bringing our dog, Georgiana, to Village West Vet for the last 8 months and I can say with certainty we'll never shop around for vet med anywhere else in the neighborhood. The care Georgiana has received and attention to detail the staff have shown in her exams is the very best. The front desk is always friendly and reaching out for follow ups after a visit to check in for any feedback or complications, via text or call. Our invoices are always broken down by item in the room, and communication has always been clear on what's needed, what's recommended, and what could stand to wait until next visit. We truly love you, VWV, and thank your vet care team for all the hard work they do!
Great 👍 from Start to finish got my Baby 🍼 Good to Go all 5 star ✨ …

Everyone here has been absolutely amazing. From the first time seeing my cat khoshekh to the recent dental surgery he needed. They've been so incredibly accommodating and kind. Both dr Kate and dr Lukas answered every question I had and took the time to answer all my questions. Cece and Manny also helped me a ton with the whole process of getting khoshekh seen and making sure I had all the information I needed to handle the before and after of the surgery. I am so thankful to have picked this vet to bring my cherished little guy to

I didn’t have the strength to write this earlier, but I would like to share my experience with this veterinary practice. The first few years were ok, we were coming here for all of our dog vaccinations and check ups, for 7 years. Unfortunately, the last few years the service has not been satisfactory. My dog started losing weight and appetite, and instead of trying to figure it out what was wrong, his veterinary was treating him for food allergies. For months she didn’t try and give effort to help him. Finally, she send us for ultrasound where it was discovered that he has a cancer that has spread and pancreatitis. After getting the results the veterinarian didn’t even called us back, I had to be persistent she to give me call back. No, it is not her fault that he got cancer, but she is responsible for not treating him properly , and doing the tests that were needed. Maybe it would be easier for him if they had, maybe he would have been in less pain. I still can’t apprehend that someone who is a veterinarian would be so not interested in helping, and so unpleasant once received the results that were devastating for us. There was no compassion.
Very kind staff and took great care of my kitty!

Had a great experience today with a vet tech Chelimar. She helped my nervous pitbull and staffing mix get blood work.
He does not like these vet but she was able to get everything he needed done. Highly recommend.
Great vet! They always are kind with our dogs.
Thank you for the 5 stars Chris!!
Frankie was well taken care of! From the front to the back staff everyone was so warn and welcoming! My dog is a little anxious but everyone handled it with grace!
Dr. Lukas Aylesworth and staff were emotionally and physically there for us. They listened to all of our concerns and answered questions! Highly recommend!
Jymmy always has my dogs looking gorgeous - he is always excited to see them and doesn't judge me when I let them go too long between grooms.
Everyone was so nice and welcoming! They listened to all my questions and concerns and addressed them well. Happy to have found our vet clinic!

Very professional and caring staff! They are always responsive, and scheduling is quick and easy, no long waiting times.

I had a bad experience with another clinic that canceled my cat’s neutering last minute after a month of waiting. I found this clinic instead, and I’m so glad I did!

Highly recommend - 100%!
Great service! My cat Ingrid is getting quality care every time I visit.

I had an outstanding experience here. As a first time visitor they waived my exam fee so I only paid for other services, if needed. Every person I interacted with was very friendly and knowledgeable. I felt heard by the vet tech and vet and I felt they explained everything well & were very transparent about cost. I will be a returning customer!

I take my dog in regularly for check ups and various issues.  Making appts is easy (online or by calling) and I usually can get an appt within a day or two.  Everyone at Village West from the front desk to vet staff are courteous and provide really great care.  I highly recommend Village West.

We recently moved to Chicago and needed to find a groomer and pet for our cat. She had an exam and full grooming. She is 18 years old and a handful at the vet and for grooming. They were really great and patient and made sure Tiggy was as comfortable as possible. James who did the grooming was so kind and gentle with her and took time to pet her and make her more comfortable during her exam. I would definitely recommend them, they took their time, explained everything and were very welcoming. Thank you!

This vet office has a great staff, very personable and caring. My partner and I have cats and they played music with some purring mixed in there to help create a calm environment. It seemed to work. They are transparent about pricing and thorough with the care instructions. I certainly recommend.
Thank you for the 5-stars!
Thank you for the 5-stars!
The team genuinely cares about pets and caring for them.👍😺 …
Che was so sweet with my anxious cat Maxine ans helped me understand all the recommended procedures . Thank you so much:)
Thank you for the 5-star review, Judith!
Thank you for the five-star rating! We appreciate your trust in our veterinary care and look forward to serving you again.
Thank you for your review and for choosing Village West Veterinary for your pet's care needs.

We’ve been taking our dog to Village West since 2023. They’ve always given the utmost care and attention to our dog, especially because she is very anxious. They take their time while always answering any questions we have. Great care all around.

I've been coming here for 10 years with my pup; and they do a great job, timely results, and urgent appointment add ons. I was really bummed to learn that Dr Bruce Silverman is no longer there and that Village West has been owned by ThrivePet healthcare (private equity owned). I still have had great experiences with the techs, who genuinely seem to love animals. It's always a very stressful time for my pup and they try to put him at ease. Most recently, they did a price match for a joint supplement for me, which I feel like most places wouldn't do. Thank you!!

Village West Vet took really good care of my cats and they are friendly and have good customer service as well! I love how they will send text messages for setting appointments and to check up on Pearl and Pluto!
Accommodating , prompt, great staff, great neighborhood vet.  Highly recommend.
Thank you for the 5-stars!
Such a wonderful, caring, and competent staff. I’ve been taking my dogs here for years, seen various vets throughout the years and they’ve all taken great care of my dogs.
staff was nice & made sure I was seen quickly. Seemed to genuinely care about my pet & listened to my concerns!
The team genuinely cares about pets and caring for them.
Excellent vet! Extremely helpful and lovely to work with.
They are so knowledgeable and caring! Highly recommend. Also, easy appointment booking.
Always so sweet with my pup 🐶 …

Very great service! Staff was super friendly with my fur baby. They were very patient and loving towards her. I was in and out of the office in less than 40 minutes. Definitely recommend to anyone looking for a place with friendly staff. Reina was the best checking in and answering questions! We even got a nice little toy. ❤️

Wonderful care! I was able to schedule a last minute appointment online for care of my cat. The staff was so kind and comprehensive explaining and going through everything about care and pricing with me. They also showed my cat so much love and made me so reassured she was in good hands!

I had my first visit with a new kitty I adopted from animal control, who is very anxious and timid. Everyone working there was wonderful, from reception to the actual checkup, and not only made us feel welcome but also did an amazing job with a cat who was obviously terrified. I'm so glad I chose Village West! It's really a relief to know we have great people who are there for us. They even contacted me the next day to ask how she was doing!
The staff and veterinarian were lovely and kind to my pup. They even gave her a little first time gift bag. Very thoughtful. I’ll definitely be back.
Thank you for the 5-stars!
Amazing, Attentive and compassionate veterinary team … They found a way to work in an appointment on the same day for my dog issue and that made all the difference.
Thank you for the 5 star rating!!! 🐾 …
Thank you for the 5-stars!

Currently, this is the best place I've encountered. Friendly staff, excellent attitude towards pets and their owners. The specialists are great; they explain everything in an easy-to-understand language and answer all questions with detailed explanations. The interior of the establishment is pleasant – clean and inspires confidence. The prices are reasonable and correspond to the average market rate. I think my pet and I have found our perfect place!
Thank you for the 5-stars!
Thank you for the 5-stars!

Had a wonderful experience at Village West! I brought my newly adopted dog in to have a bump checked, and Dr. Lukas was incredibly kind and gentle with her. He did a great job explaining the prognosis, never rushed the appointment, and took extra time to answer other general questions I had. After the visit, Village West sent a detailed follow-up email recapping everything we discussed and outlining next steps. The entire experience felt much more personal and calming for both me and my dog compared to my previous vet. You can truly tell that Dr. Lukas cares deeply about the animals he treats. This will definitely be my go-to vet moving forward.
Thank you for the 5 star rating!!
I had a Great experience
Well organized, very clean, the staff explain everything and show you the itemized bill prior to initiating the exam, I would recommend them for all of your pet needs

It was emergency for me and  Unique (my tea cup size puppy) to visit Village West Veterinary. We were met with kindness and I was impressed by attention and professionalism of Dr. Lukas Aylesworth, who helped a lot to decide our problem. I’m thankful to the people, who love pets and devote themselves to save health and life of our beloved pets!
Thank you for the 5 Star Review!!!🐾 …
Thank You for your review!!

Reyna the vet technician was outstanding!  So genuine and very sweet with my two poodles!  I was extremely relieved they could clean out one of my poodles ears.  My Hazel is very resistant and mission accomplished!  The veterinarian was thorough and helpful with my concerns.  This is why I rate with 5 stars.

Edit: All lies in response!

I’m  not sure why my previous review was deleted, but I’m rewriting it because people deserve to know what happened.

My family spent thousands of dollars here for my cat, Cinder, and there was no follow-up at all. Because of this lack of communication and disorganization, my cat ultimately passed away. What was the point of all that money if basic competence and care weren’t provided?

I understand that veterinary work can be demanding, but we’re talking about lives and thousands of dollars. What makes this worse is that when I pressed them for answers, I was told they were “getting used to a new system”—the exact same excuse they gave months ago in response to another negative review. Did they really think no one would notice?

More recently, I brought in my other cat, Sphinx. I asked for a breakdown of the charges for that specific visit, and suddenly a handful of unnecessary tests appeared—tests I knew I would never receive results for. When I questioned it, the cost dropped by about $50. If I hadn’t been proactive, I would’ve been charged for services I didn’t need.

If you want transparency, integrity, and genuine care for your animals, go to Ukrainian Village Vet. They walk you through every charge and actually work with you. Some veterinarians care about animals. Unfortunately, this place has shown me that they do not.

If my post gets deleted again, I will keep re-writing it :)
Staff was very attentive
Thank you for the 5-stars!

We love village west. They are always accommodating, knowledgeable and helpful. Everyone but especially CC is incredible sweet to my dog Rosie. She is obsessed with CC. Thanks for all the love and treats you give.
We’re nice and kind and very respectful
The staff were very professional both the vet and the tech Che were very detailed in explaining everything.
Village West Vet does a great job taking care of my cat! They have a fear free environment and are quick and professional. I’m glad that my cat is in their care.
My dog (surprisingly) loves our vet! Great office with great people and clear information on their services.
Thank you for the 5-stars!

Village West Vet provided an amazing experience for our very nervous dog's annual healthcare appointment. I left feeling assured she is going to have another happy and healthy year. Special shout out to the staff who also welcomed my children to participate in the appointment and sent them home with materials to learn more about animals and veterinary medicine. I couldn't ask for anything more !

Okay, so Thor had a big visit! Multiple health concerns on top of annual shots and prescription refills, as well as a full groom (cut, bath, nails, all of it). Everyone was so great!

We saw the Jimmy the groomer first. My dog HATES being groomed. Like, a bath is literally the end of the world. Somehow though, Jimmy the Dogwhisperer is Thor's absolute best friend!

On to the exam, doggie anxiety starts kicking in, and he's shaking like a leaf. Our technician, Sonia, was efficient and gentle. She made sure to give Thor a bit of squeeze cheese after the big, scary stethoscope, and he was putty in her hands.

Then we see Dr. Aylesworth. Wow, what a great exam. Professional, knowledgeable, and took extra time to answer every one of my questions (of which, there were many!). He wrapped up giving us a list of things to watch for and providing different recommendations for future care. Recommendations, for the record, that weren't just trying to upsell some product they have on the shelf or something, but things that may help my aging pup that they wouldn't profit on by recommending.

If I could give 10 stars, I would. 20 even! This is definitely the place to go!
Manny is great! Very sweet and helpful.
Your positive experience means everything to us. We're grateful for your trust in our care.
Great option

I have been taking my golden doodle to Village West for grooming and have been totally happy with the service Ive received. The receptionist is very friendly and helpful and my groomer, Jimmy, is the best. His concern for “Otto’s”well being and my requests is beyond compare. I give them high marks in customer satisfaction.

I brought my dog in for what turned out to be a tooth infection. He was prescribed meds that cleared up the infection in a week. During the exam, the vet said my dog had an irregular heart beat and told me to go to a specialist. Turns out my dog’s heart is normal but because of this vet, I paid a specialist $1,200 to tell me that. I also received an insanely expensive estimate from VWV to get my dog’s teeth cleaned, it ranged from $2,400-$4,400. Overall, I’m grateful they fixed my dog’s problem but I just can’t justify how expensive this place is. I took him to another vet who did his dental for less than $700.
Robbery….$1017 quote for a kitten spay + $403 for the pre op appointment.
Both of our dogs have been well taken care of here and we have always felt listened to and heard. Thanks!
Thank you for the 5-stars!
Thanks for the 5-stars!
New doctor - Dr Aleswirth - is great.   Very happy with service.  Nurses and front desk all A+.

They've been everything I was hoping for at this stage in my dog's health journey. Accessible, open-minded, kind... Having been to four other vets (one dismissed him as allergies, and two were in the same office but rotating their expertise. The other was two hours away in Wisconsin as a budget gamble) and still needed higher level consults they have been the perfect liason and troubleshooter in the interim. Very happy with my visits as an analytical pet parent. Dr. Keets is doing incredible work and will be our primary moving forward!
We are delighted to hear about your positive experience with our team! Thank you for choosing Village West Veterinary.

For more than seven years, our River has been lovingly cared for by the doctors, technicians and staff at Village West. And, more recently, the wonderful Jimmy has joined their team as a groomer. We feel fortunate that this practice is in our neighborhood--but would willingly travel great distances for the warm, professional service(s) they provide.
Thank you for the 5-star review.

Horrible experience. The vet tech was wrestling with my young dog in an unbelievably unprofessional way that riled him up and made him difficult for the rest of this visit. Zero etiquette at all. The vet then was incredibly cross with us about very basic and normal medications, and totally dismissive of concerns we had before attempting to overcharge us for a prescription. Avoid at all costs.
Very nice and my cat loved everybody there.
Always happy w how my precious baby is treated here
We are pleased to hear about your positive experience at Village West Veterinary. Thank you for sharing your feedback.
Really good experience, took my cat’s issue seriously and really worked with me on the price when I couldn’t afford the initial estimate 👍 …
Exceptional service. And very kind
Very disappointed with the visit , can’t believe that I had to ask the vet to check my cat’s body temperature?! Unprofessional service, won’t be back or recommending the clinic.

My normal vet was not available, so I called Village West and got a same day appointment for my cat.  She became suddenly ill and was the most lethargic I had ever seen her.  I was pleased with the kind service by everyone from the front desk, to the vet tech, to the veterinarian. Dr. Konishi and the vet tech (I apologize for not remembering the tech's name) were thorough and sent us home after some diagnostic testing and treatment. Since it was a Friday, I was given instructions to monitor and bring to an emergency room if my cat's condition worsened.  Unfortunately, my little nugget passed yesterday, but I appreciate Village West's attempt to minimize her discomfort. I had a senior cat with kidney disease, and while I have a lot of grief, I think my experience with Dr. Konishi has helped minimize the guilt that comes with saying goodbye.
Easy to make convenient appointment.  Great service & care.

Took my healthy older cat in because of what looked like a cyst on her paw. They refused treatment and said they aren’t going to do any labs or remove it because my cat wasn’t worth saving because of her age. I was appalled that they said such a thing and they were completely unphased by what they said. During her exam they were very rough with her and she tried to bite back— she isn’t a biter and she tends to love people. I do not recommend this vet clinic. I don’t remember the name of the vet of who I saw but they were terrible. Go to BLVD Logan Square instead— they actually care about your pets.

Would rate zero stars.
My dog was stung by a bee and showing signs of a severe allergic reaction. Without having a car, and being in a panic, I figured the fastest way I could get my …

It is 2023-2024 and we now have thrive healthcare with new vets. I had spoken with Manny regarding lesser care for my 19 year old cat than when she was younger and my disappointment with that. Things changed. Today, 08.22.24, a last minute …
Very nice service, everyone was nice as well. I like this office, I think I will make this my new veterinarian office for my pet.
